profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Collective Health
profile.summary:
SUMMARY PROFILE:
-	5+ years experience in Java programming.
-	Knowledge in building full-stack applications with modern framework such as Ruby on Rails, Spring, Angular, and React.
-	Familiar with automation using shell scripts, managing projects using various tools such as Maven, NPM, Ruby Gem
-	Being assistive when in need.
-	Knowledge sharing, and team communication for work efficiency
-	A good team player and workload shareable mate.
-	Able to work under high-pressure environment.
-	Being skillful in explaining working procedure and product processing.
-	Familiar with Agile Software Development method
-	Willing to travel.


TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE:
-	Programming Languages: Java. Familiar with Javascript, HTML, SQL, XML, C/C++, Objective-C, PHP, Hive.
-	Database: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis.
-	IDE: Sublime, Eclipse, Netbeans, Visual Studio, XCode.
-	Vendor Application: Amazon EC2, SourceTree, Cloudera, PerForce on Windows

positions.title: Associate Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and implement document manager component using React, Redux and Ruby on Rails for managing various type of clinical document on cloud environment.
    • Implement document caching logic in order to enable application offline mode.
    • Troubleshoot issue related to loading, synchronization, and iOS devices specific type.
    • Troubleshoot build issues on Jenkin and docker container.
    • Improve application user experience through workflow redesign.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full-stack development with front-end Windows base app and back-end Java EJS server.
    • Redesign service response logic for providing more insight to patient care system.
    • Enhance documentation security system by enabling organization limit access feature.
    • Actively troubleshoot client issues, and application performance enhancement.
    • Participate in complete software development life cycle: Design, Develop, Test, Release.
    • Contribute to code reviewing and code quality improvement.

positions.title: Web UI Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Design and implement front end solutions
•	Review and understand functional User Interface (UI) requirements to be able to conceive and present application designs and UI prototypes focusing on workflow and usability
•	Document and publish requirement, design and functional specifications for use by internal teams
•	Implement new UI functionality using state of the art industry standard frameworks
•	Participate in the evaluation and resolution of defect ticket reports for new as well as legacy components
•	Contribute to the team’s software development life-cycle improvement initiatives by utilizing standard practices as well proposing areas of improvement – design, planning, implementation, testing, and documentation
Lead Proof of Concept (POC) from concept to release and communicate with management and development team regarding status, progress, and projected delivery

positions.title: Teacher Assistant (TA)
positions.description:
-	Present working procedure, and provide tutorials and instructions of LinkedList, ArrayList, HashMap, HashTable, and Hashset in Java.
-	Assist students in building Unix Script.
-	Guide student to work with version control software (Git). SourceTree.
-	Develop effective programming style, including critical thinking and problem solving.

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
Grad Projects:

Mobile Test As A Service Platform	                                Spring 2015
•	Construct a Testing Platform for Mobile App using Amazon EC2 as infrastructure
•	Analyze user statistical usage and calculate the cost per resource consumption
•	Design tool suites to support testing function
•	Using dynamic resource allocation to improve the system high-availability
•	Technologies use: MongoDB, JSP, MySQL, Tomcat, Android SDK, Javascript

PhotoApp: Photo Album Sharing App				Spring 2015
-	Create a photo album sharing mobile app using Java and Android SDK
-	Support Image upload to an existing server
-	Use Facebook Oauth2 authentication to identify users and friends.
-	Collect Image geo-location meta using Android Location Service
-	Technologies used: MongoDB for Image Storing, Rest API using Spring Boot, Android API 19, Java.

Mortage Calculator - iOS	Spring 2015
•	Create a Mortage Calculator that calculate Mortage value and display Mortage data on map.
•	Store calculated data to SQLLite database.
•	Technologies used: Objective-C, XCode, iOS Core Location, Google Map API for Streetview, Git.

Undergrad Projects:

Library Management	Fall 2014
-	Constructed a database to handle the library management
-	Ensured data consistency over concurrent access using Trigger and Constraint
-	Manage access control and prevent outside attacks 
-	Technologies used: MySQL, HTML5, CSS, Javascript, PHP

iNews: Question Answering System	                       Spring 2014
-	Constructed a database of answers from StackOverFlow.
-	Aggregated data for statistical analysis
-	Experimented question classification using Decision Tree, Bayes Classifier, Naïve Bayes Classifier
-	Built Unix scripts to pipe mini programs
-      Queried and aggregated data on MySQL with SQL language, on MongoDB with Javascript and DOM, and on Redis with provided API.
-	Technology used: Hadoop, YARN, Redis, HBase, MongoDB, MySQL, Weka 6, PHP, Javascript.

positions.title: Windows Driver Development Intern
positions.description:
-	Contribute to the development of SmartHBA devices on Windows side
-	Build and deploy drivers for SmartHBA device using Visual Studio.
-	Test and develop driver for SmartHBA on Windows 7, Windows Server 2008, Windows 8 and Windows Server 2012
-	Debug and observe device behavior using WinDBG, WinUART
-	Communicate with BIOS and hardware development team to identify problems causes
-	Report driver test result and propose solution to simple driver problems
